segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the updated quote for the analytics workspace before I send it over for signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. I’ve got about fifteen minutes. We’re still looking at 42 seats total, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, 42 standard seats. The annual subscription comes to $37,800, and then the one-time onboarding package is $4,500. That includes the admin setup session and two team trainings.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I had. The start date would be May 1?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, May 1 contract start, with access turned on that morning. If we get signature by April 24, we can hold the kickoff for the week of May 6.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. On billing, can the invoice be net 30 and sent to ap at our finance alias?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, net 30 is already in the order form. I’ll add the finance alias as the billing contact before it goes out.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. And the renewal term is twelve months, not auto-renewing for multiple years?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, initial term is twelve months. It renews annually unless either side gives 30 days’ notice. No multi-year commitment in this version.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and our controller, Marcus Lee. If the numbers are the same, we should be able to sign this week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send the order form and the service schedule today, and I’ll copy Marcus. Let me know if procurement wants any formatting changes.
